name: NO_VEHICLES_WHITE_SQUARE

qld_tc2345_car.desc: car (side view, facing right) c 428 wide, from the sheet's grid inset; height measured on the drawing

notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Sheet 'c' is the white edge and 'd' the edge + border (read as AS 1743 does: 10/30 = edge 10 + border 20, 5/15 = 5 + 10, 15/45 = 15 + 30), confirmed against the national R-series pairs. TC-series sheet TC2345 'No vehicles' regulatory sign (2020). Size A 600 x 600 generated (B 900, C 1200 also tabled): r 50, unbordered white, margin b 6 to the annulus (outer dia 588). The sheet tables only a, b, c (symbol width 428) and r: the ring width, slash and gap are not dimensioned, so the TC9998 'No motorcycles' size-B values for the same 600 sign are used (R294 / R244 ring, slash 50 at 45 degrees, white gap 25), which match the drawing. Prohibition sign per the sheet's detail: red annulus r1 outside / r2 inside centred on the sign, the black symbol traced from the sheet (black layer only), a white gap e each side of the red slash f wide at 45 degrees from upper-left to lower-right (drawn as a white slash f + 2e wide inside the ring under the red slash), the slashes are rectangles whose corners lie on their circle (ends within the ring band). Car symbol 428 wide centred, height 205 measured on the drawing (tools/symbols/qld_tc2345_car.svg). Red and black on white.
